queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Google Earth Pro' AND publisher = 'Google';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Google Earth Pro' AND publisher = 'Google' AND version_compare(version, '7.3.7.1327') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'google earth pro.exe');
